records.title: WaveGrad: Estimating Gradients for Waveform Generation
records.reason: The abstract identifies waveform generation as the target model; it does not propose an LLM serving optimization.

records.title: MambaIR: A Simple Baseline for Image Restoration with State-Space Model
records.reason: The primary abstract describes image restoration and image restoration benchmarks; no LLM inference improvement is claimed.

records.title: A Review on Large Language Models: Architectures, Applications, Taxonomies, Open Issues and Challenges
records.reason: This is a broad LLM survey and may help trace relevant deployment work, but the publisher-version review offers no original method or measured inference improvement. Keep borderline as background discovery only, not as an optimization result.

records.title: MobileNetV4 - Universal Models for the Mobile Ecosystem
records.reason: Treat as borderline transfer candidate: its mobile attention kernel may inspire efficient LLM attention, but the full text benchmarks MobileNet/image workloads only; no evidence establishes compatibility with causal attention, KV cache, or language quality.

records.title: Autoregressive Image Generation without Vector Quantization
records.reason: Its parallel token prediction is for image-generation latents, with visual sample quality results; the autoregressive term does not make this a language-model inference method.
